blocker.operation: GitHub.update_file on data/leads_master.csv, data/contacts.csv and data/evidence.csv
blocker.reason: fetch_blob can return complete large blobs, but the automation runtime cannot pass the returned multi-hundred-kilobyte body into update_file without reconstructing the entire file text. GitHub contents API has no append operation, and repository network access is unavailable in the execution container.
blocker.verified_read_method: fetch_file lines 1-1 to obtain blob SHA, then GitHub.fetch_blob
blocker.required_resolution: An append/patch-capable GitHub connector operation, or authenticated repository checkout/network access, is required to merge GRM-120 and GRM-121 safely into the three canonical CSV files.
